sections.heading: MAJOR IN GLOBAL SOCIAL INNOVATION
lines: Centre for Global Social Innovation - Faculty of Arts and Social Science

Completion of first-year requirements, including at least 1.0 essay course, satisfied with either two half–year courses or one full–year course, with a mark of at least 60%. Anthropology, Centre for Global Social Innovation, English, Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies, Geography and Environment, History, Indigenous Studies, Media, Information and Technoculture, Philosophy, Political Science, Social Justice and Peace Studies, and Sociology are recommended first year courses.
1.0 course from: GSI 3509F/G, GSI 3514F/G, GSI 3517F/G, GSI 3530F/G.
1.0 course from: GSI 3513F/G, GSI 3525F/G, GSI 3527F/G, GSI 3528F/G.

2.0 courses from: GSI 3000-4999 level; or up to 1.0 non–GSI course at the 2200 level or higher from Arts and Humanities, Social Science, or Information and Media Studies that engages directly with Global Social Innovation content, as approved by the Centre for Global Social Innovation.
